# External data

`qmof.csv` (QMOF Database, 20,372 entries used here) is not redistributed.
Download it from the QMOF Database (https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.13147324)
and place it here as `data/external/qmof.csv`. Cite:
A. S. Rosen et al., Matter 4 (2021) 1578-1597; npj Comput. Mater. 8 (2022) 112.

Columns used: info.formula, info.natoms, info.pld, info.lcd, info.density,
info.volume, outputs.pbe.bandgap (and, for the leakage-only feature set E,
outputs.pbe.energy_total/energy_vdw/energy_elec/net_magmom).
